item.description:
### Changed - **Perch does less work when a Claude session has just started.** It no longer searches every project folder for the session's transcript on each check before Claude has written one. - The Stats window and the Licence settings take less work to draw.
### Fixed - **Perch no longer takes over a Droid status line it didn't write.** Installing or removing Perch's Droid integration now leaves your status line alone unless it is Perch's own. - A Claude session waiting on a permission keeps showing that it needs you, even when Perch briefly can't read the session's files. - Perch finds OpenCode's database in the same place OpenCode does when you set `XDG_DATA_HOME` or `OPENCODE_DB` in your shell. - When Perch can't move something to the Trash from Storage settings, it now tells you why. - Diagnostics now include Droid and Muse.
